vi: Nhận biết secret model của App Platform khác AWS Secrets Manager: secret là field trong App Spec (type = SECRET), không resource độc lập, không version/rotation/per-secret-IAM, giá trị lưu trong state plaintext.

Kỹ năng viết `digitalocean_app` full-spec: name/region, `spec.service` (name/instance_size_slug/http_port), `image` block (DOCKER_HUB pull public), `health_check`, env (type = GENERAL/SECRET, scope = RUN_TIME), `autoscaling` block scale theo CPU.
Thực hành inject env SECRET an toàn: DB_PASSWORD từ `database_user.password` DO tự sinh, DATABASE_URL từ cluster.uri, env SECRET DO encrypt-at-rest + che UI/log, nhưng vẫn nằm state file.
Hiểu firewall trusted-source type app: không hardcode IP instance (thay đổi khi scale), không IAM-grant per-app, chỉ cho app id cụ thể kết nối DB qua private_host.
Dọn tài nguyên PaaS: app + cluster tính tiền theo giờ, không pause mode, destroy bắt buộc sau lab, kiểm tra `doctl apps list` + `doctl databases list`, xác nhận billing reset.
en: Recognize App Platform's secret model differs from AWS Secrets Manager: a secret is a field in the App Spec (`type = SECRET`), not a standalone resource, no versioning/rotation/per-secret-IAM, the value sits in state in plaintext.

Write a complete `digitalocean_app` with full spec: name/region, `spec.service` (name/instance_size_slug/http_port), an `image` block (pull public from DOCKER_HUB), `health_check`, env fields (type = GENERAL/SECRET, scope = RUN_TIME), `autoscaling` block scales by CPU.

Practice injecting SECRET env safely: DB_PASSWORD from DO-generated `database_user.password`, DATABASE_URL from cluster.uri, DO encrypts SECRET at rest + hides it from UI/logs, but the value still sits in state.
Understand trusted-source `type = app` firewall: don't hardcode instance IP (it changes on scale), no per-app IAM grant, only the specific app id may reach the DB via private_host.
Clean up PaaS resources: app + cluster bill hourly with no pause, `terraform destroy` is mandatory after the lab, verify with `doctl apps list` + `doctl databases list`, confirm billing resets.
